1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.FacetAngleSums
2 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.VertexFanIncidence
3 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.UniversalVertexFaceCounting
4 
5 /-! Surface angle and curvature computed directly from the original faces.
6 For the six-vertex universal-source case, a total-curvature upper bound is
7 sufficient; it follows from the face count without a global Euler formula. -/
8 
9 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
10 
11 open Set Real
12 
13 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} [Fintype P.Face]
14 
15 /-- The total angle of all original faces incident to a vertex. -/
16 noncomputable def surfaceAngle (P : ConvexPolyhedron) [Fintype P.Face] (v : P.Vertex) : ℝ :=
17   ∑ F : P.Face, F.cornerAngle v
18 
19 /-- The actual angle deficit at an original vertex. -/
20 noncomputable def vertexCurvature (P : ConvexPolyhedron) [Fintype P.Face] (v : P.Vertex) : ℝ :=
21   2 * π - P.surfaceAngle v
22 
23 /-- A complete local fan sums exactly the angles of the original incident faces. -/
24 theorem VertexFaceFan.totalAngle_eq_surfaceAngle {v : P.Vertex} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n]
25     (fan : P.VertexFaceFan v n) (size : P.vertices.card ≤ 6)
26     (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
27       (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4) :
28     fan.totalAngle = P.surfaceAngle v := by
29   apply Fintype.sum_of_injective fan.face (fan.faces_injective size small_faces)
30     fan.sectorAngle (fun F => F.cornerAngle v)
31   · intro F absent
32     exact F.cornerAngle_of_not_mem v (fun member => absent ((fan.covers small_faces F).mp member))
33   · intro i
34     exact ((fan.face i).cornerAngle_eq (small_faces _) v (fan.neighbor i) (fan.neighbor (i + 1))
35       (fan.successive_distinct i) (fan.pole_mem i) (fan.left_mem i) (fan.right_mem i)
36       (fan.adjacent i) (fan.adjacent (i + 1))).symm
37 
38 /-- Every actual vertex has strictly less than a full turn of surface angle. -/
39 theorem surfaceAngle_lt_two_pi (size : P.vertices.card ≤ 6)
40     (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
41       (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4) (v : P.Vertex) :
42     P.surfaceAngle v < 2 * π := by
43   have degree := P.edgeGraph_min_degree v
44   letI : NeZero (P.edgeGraph.degree v) := ⟨by omega⟩
45   obtain ⟨fan⟩ := P.exists_vertex_face_fan size small_faces v rfl
46   rw [← fan.totalAngle_eq_surfaceAngle size small_faces]
47   exact fan.totalAngle_lt_two_pi size small_faces
48 
49 theorem vertexCurvature_pos (size : P.vertices.card ≤ 6)
50     (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
51       (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4) (v : P.Vertex) :
52     0 < P.vertexCurvature v :=
53   sub_pos.mpr (surfaceAngle_lt_two_pi size small_faces v)
54 
55 /-- Counting each corner by its face or by its vertex gives the same angle sum. -/
56 theorem sum_surfaceAngle
57     (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
58       (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4) :
59     (∑ v : P.Vertex, P.surfaceAngle v) =
60       ((∑ F : P.Face, ((F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) * π := by
61   simp only [surfaceAngle]
62   rw [Finset.sum_comm]
63   simp_rw [Face.sum_cornerAngles _ (small_faces _)]
64   rw [Nat.cast_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
65 
66 /-- The universal-source case needs only this upper bound on total curvature. -/
67 theorem universal_sum_vertexCurvature_le (size : P.vertices.card = 6)
68     (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
69       (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4)
70     (source : P.Vertex) (universal : ∀ v : P.Vertex, v ≠ source → P.edgeGraph.Adj source v) :
71     (∑ v : P.Vertex, P.vertexCurvature v) ≤ 4 * π := by
72   have count := universal_vertex_face_angle_weight size small_faces source universal
73   have real_count : (8 : ℝ) ≤
74       ((∑ F : P.Face, ((F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
75     exact_mod_cast count
76   have angle_bound := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right real_count Real.pi_pos.le
77   have vertex_count : Fintype.card P.Vertex = 6 := by simpa [Vertex] using size
78   simp only [vertexCurvature, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const,
79     Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul, vertex_count]
80   rw [sum_surfaceAngle small_faces]
81   norm_num at angle_bound ⊢
82   linarith
83 
84 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
